_about: The section that shows a person their own address for sending notes and voice memos into Trillion from a phone or computer without the Trillion app (src/account-screens.mjs inboundAddressSection), on Use Trillion in your AI and Connections; never a setup step, because the Trillion Mac app reads Notes and Voice Memos by itself. {address} is their address (src/inbound-mail.mjs).
heading: Send notes and voice memos to Trillion
body: On a phone or computer without the Trillion app, send notes and voice memos to this address and they arrive in Trillion, where your AI picks them up.

steps.title: Copy your address
steps.body: It is yours alone, so keep it like a phone number.

steps.title: Share a note or voice memo to it
steps.body: In Apple Notes or Voice Memos, press Share, choose Mail and send it to this address. Any email you send it arrives the same way.
